extension.description: Sets the audio and subtitle track according to your language preferences
根据你的语言偏好自动选择音轨与字幕轨道
Ställer in ljud- och undertextspår enligt dina språkinställningar
extension.disclaimer: For bugs, requests or general questions visit the Language Preference Manager thread on the Kodi forum.
如遇到 Bug、功能需求或相关问题，请前往 Kodi 论坛的语言偏好管理器主题帖反馈。
För buggar, önskemål eller allmänna frågor, besök tråden Language Preference Manager på Kodi-forumet.
extension.news: 1.1.1Beta1 : - Add regional/script language preferences for English, French, Spanish, Portuguese and Chinese, grouped with their base language in settings (Thanks to Hugs11). - Prefer exact BCP-47 tags or recognized track-title variants, then unlabelled tracks of the same language; preserve generic language preferences (Thanks to Hugs11). - Add Chinese translation (Thanks to wabisabi926). - Avoid some wrong seekback decisions in subtitles delayed workaround.
